```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet")
```

```{r}
set.seed(9) 
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  collect() |>
  slice_sample(n = 10) 
```

```{r}
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  filter(date_raw >= "2025-01-01") |>
  group_by(coin_id) |>
  summarise(mean_mcap = mean(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE), days = n()) |>
  arrange(desc(mean_mcap)) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
prices <- open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  collect()
metadata <- open_dataset("data/coin_metadata.parquet") |>
  collect()
categories <- open_dataset("data/categories.parquet") |>
  collect()
categories
```
```{r}
metadata |>
  select(coin_id, coin_name, launch_date)
```
```{r}
metadata |>
  mutate(launch = as_date(parse_date_time(launch_date, orders = c("mdy", "ymd")))) |>
  arrange(launch) |>
  select(coin_id, launch_date, launch)
```

```{r} 
prices |>
  filter(coin_id == "btc") |>
  mutate(date = ymd(date_raw)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = price_usd)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Price (USD)", title = "Bitcoin daily price") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
prices |>
  left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  left_join(select(categories, -description), by = "category_id")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
prices <- open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  collect()
metadata <- open_dataset("data/coin_metadata.parquet") |>
  collect()
categories <- open_dataset("data/categories.parquet") |>
  collect()

crypto <- prices |>
  left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  left_join(select(categories, -description), by = "category_id") |>
  mutate(date = ymd(date_raw))

```

```{r}
crypto |>
  mutate(
    date = ymd(date_raw),
    category_name = fct_reorder(category_name, market_cap_usd, .fun = sum, .desc = TRUE)
  ) |>
  group_by(date, category_name) |>
  summarize(cat_mcap = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = cat_mcap, fill = category_name)) +
  geom_area(position = "fill") +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = as.Date(c("2022-05-09", "2022-11-08")),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  annotate(
    "label",
    x = as.Date("2022-05-09"),
    y = 0.88,
    label = "Luna/UST crash\n(May 2022)",
    size = 3,
    hjust = 1.05,
    fill = "white",
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  annotate(
    "label",
    x = as.Date("2022-11-08"),
    y = 0.72,
    label = "FTX collapse\n(Nov 2022)",
    size = 3,
    hjust = -0.05,
    fill = "white",
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "viridis", direction = -1) +
  labs(
    title = "Crypto Market Share by Sector",
    subtitle = "Bitcoin dominance gave way to smart contract platforms and stablecoins, with sharp shifts around major market shocks",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Share of Total Market Cap",
    fill = "Category",
    caption = "Source: CoinGecko / PPBDS Crypto Dataset (22 major coins)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```
